2607.18235.title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
2607.18235.paper_summary: Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe. Because discovery runs are expensive and inherently stochastic, existing harnesses are often compared using too few independent trials to distinguish key methodological improvements from run-to-run variance. We systematically decompose OpenEvolve-style evolutionary search and the TTT-Discover search harness into its constituent components and systematically evaluate 30 budget-matched harnesses across 12 model-problem pairs using more than 3.1 million LLM rollouts and repeated-trial statistical analysis. Our results show that discovery harnesses have a generalization problem: No fixed harness is reliably superior across the evaluated model-problem pairs, and variants of OpenEvolve generally underperform simpler alternatives. Thus, harness choice is better viewed as a hyperparameter rather than as a universal recipe, and should be tailored to the specific problem and underlying model. We also find that early discovery progress predicts final performance, and use this property to present a budget-matched adaptive-allocation experiment that starts multiple harnesses, prunes weak partial runs, and reallocates compute to stronger survivors, outperforming both commitment to a randomly sampled fixed harness and a non-adaptive harness ensemble. Together, these results motivate shifting from fixed harness selection to online adaptation guided by early performance. We release all run pools including baseline null distributions for every model-problem pair as reusable statistical infrastructure against for future harness proposals.
2607.18235.paper_summary_zh: 自主發現系統如 OpenEvolve 和 TTT-Discover 通常被用作通用的工具。<lb/>然而，在實際應用中，這些系統是將多種設計選擇（關於檔案、父代選擇、探索和預算分配）組合成單一配方的複合系統。<lb/>由於發現運行的成本高且本質上具有隨機性，現有的工具通常使用過少的獨立試驗進行比較，以區分關鍵的方法改進與運行之間的變異。<lb/>我們系統性地將 OpenEvolve 風格的進化搜索和 TTT-Discover 搜索工具分解為其組成部分，並系統性地評估 30 個預算匹配的工具，涵蓋 12 對模型-問題，使用超過 310 萬次 LLM 展開和重複試驗的統計分析。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，發現工具存在泛化問題：在評估的模型-問題對中，沒有固定的工具能夠可靠地優於其他工具，而 OpenEvolve 的變體通常表現不如更簡單的替代方案。<lb/>因此，工具的選擇應被視為超參數，而非通用配方，並應根據特定問題和基礎模型進行調整。<lb/>我們還發現，早期的發現進展能預測最終表現，並利用這一特性提出一個預算匹配的自適應分配實驗，該實驗啟動多個工具，修剪弱的部分運行，並將計算資源重新分配給更強的存活者，超越了對隨機抽樣固定工具的承諾和非自適應工具集的表現。<lb/>總體而言，這些結果促使我們從固定工具選擇轉向由早期表現指導的在線適應。<lb/>我們釋放所有運行池，包括每個模型-問題對的基線零分佈，作為未來工具提案的可重用統計基礎設施。
